answer: To resist Sybil attacks in AI agent economies, agents must forge unique identity certificates by embedding scarce digital tokens analogous to jade and marble into cryptographic commitments. The system verifies that each token is unique and non-transferable without burning, forcing attackers to acquire fresh scarce resources for every fake identity. This raises the attacker cost dramatically as mass Sybil creation demands large capital for multiple unique jade-marble equivalents, while honest agents maintain a single bond that can be reused across interactions.
